options.label: Gear icon, last in the header tools
options.notes: What is built now: one framework IconButton with the settings icon, last in the screen header's tools strip (fx-pagehead__tools), labelled '<Plugin> settings'. Smallest; on a phone it wraps under the title.

options.label: Gear with the word Settings
options.notes: The same control with the word Settings beside the icon, still last in the tools strip. Easier to spot and to tap on a phone; takes more room in busy headers.

options.label: Gear beside the screen title
options.notes: The gear sits right after the screen's title instead of at the far end, so it reads as 'this screen's settings' and never competes with the screen's own actions.
